source_scope: KAIMAN/KERAKAM manufacturer technical album: explanatory pages 1–35, index pages 36–40, detail sheets physical pages 41–267
critical_findings: The PDF physically contains 267 pages; the machine source has 227 indexed detail sheets on physical pages 41–267. v2.2 maps all 227 detail units to the source wall taxonomy instead of treating them as generic ceramic-wall records.

Table 3.1 on physical pages 7–9 was converted into a source-traceable component catalogue: 19 ceramic-unit variants and 4 PKB lintel variants. Only source-explicit envelope dimensions are considered BIM-usable; internal void geometry is not reconstructed from raster images.

Section 10 wall taxonomy was encoded into 19 wall-type branches covering KAIMAN 38/KERAKAM 38 Thermo, KERAKAM 38, 44, 51, KERAKAM 25/25XL and KAIMAN 30 with facing-brick, render or external-insulation branches and source-declared loadbearing/nonbearing classes.

24 source-wide technical facts were typed once and inherited by applicable details (mortar joint 10–15 mm, half-block bond, tie requirements, slab/lintel bearing, plaster thickness, movement-joint guidance, etc.). They remain technical-album claims and are not silently promoted to current norms.

All 227 KAIMAN/KERAKAM Archicad IR graphs now know the wall type, allowed source product variant(s), finish branch and structural junction class. Exact detail commit remains locked until sheet-specific printed dimensions and project structural parameters are bound.
A 227-record dimension-binding queue was created so remaining sheet-by-sheet extraction is explicit and finite rather than hidden behind generic blockers.
